text_markup: The symbol [trash] represents trashing the object it appears on. It is used as a cost for certain abilities.
text_plain: The symbol {trash} represents trashing the object it appears on. It is used as a cost for certain abilities.

examples.text_markup: {card:Fall Guy}'s last ability reads "[trash]: Gain 2[c]." The cost to trigger this ability is to trash {card:Fall Guy}.
examples.text_plain: Fall Guy's last ability reads "{trash}: Gain 2{c}." The cost to trigger this ability is to trash Fall Guy.
